# Spot the Difference AI

> A relaxing, mobile-first spot-the-difference puzzle game with AI-generated levels, daily challenges, achievements, and a global leaderboard.

Spot the Difference AI is a Progressive Web App puzzle game. Each level pairs two nearly-identical scenes with five hidden differences. Play a story campaign across four themed worlds, chase a daily challenge for streak rewards, or pick Infinite, Timed, or Relax modes. Progress, coins, XP, and achievements are saved to your account.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Game overview and mode picker.
- [Story Map](/story): Four themed worlds with hand-crafted levels.
- [Daily Challenge](/play/daily): One new puzzle per day with streak rewards.
- [Infinite Levels](/play/infinite): Endless random levels.
- [Timed Mode](/play/timed): Beat the 90-second clock.
- [Relax Mode](/play/relax): No timer, unlimited hints.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Top players by XP and level.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Create a free account to save progress.
